add-item.note: The add button opens a creation dialog (icon first, then required title and description). The icon select lists the full built-in catalog with a preview, unless iconOptions overrides it. Confirming emits the payload — the host below appends it as a new section.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearance.note: Boxed renders a bordered card; lined renders a flat row with a divider under the trigger; plain has no borders.

collapsible.basic-content: Manage your personal information, notification preferences, and security settings here.
collapsible.basic-note: The trigger toggles the panel. Focus the trigger and press Enter or Space to toggle via keyboard.
collapsible.controlled-content: This panel is controlled by the host component.
collapsible.controlled-note: The open state is owned by the host. Use [(open)] for two-way binding.
collapsible.description: Disclosure primitive that toggles the visibility of a content region with an accessible trigger.
collapsible.disabled-content: This content can never be expanded while disabled.
collapsible.disabled-note: A disabled collapsible cannot be toggled and removes the trigger from the tab order.

examples.note: Start with the default collapsible, then explore appearances and sizes below.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

leading-icon.note: Optional icon glued to the label, rendered before the expand chevron.

collapsible.open-on-init-content: This collapsible starts open and can be collapsed.
collapsible.open-on-init-note: Pass [open]="true" to render the panel expanded.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density work together in the component. Combine both controls to see every combination.

collapsible.sizes-note: The size input reserves density. All variants share the same ARIA pattern.
